rv.q: The great strength of Warchus' production is its sensitivity to the play's ragged mixture of styles and tones.
Hoffman and Reilly, regardless of the role each is playing at the moment, transcend the limits of this production, and make True West one of the few "must see" plays of this season.

cn.t: Shepard's classic gets a blistering revival that marks his first Broadway hit, powered by Hoffman and Reilly's acclaimed role-swapping performances in this two-hander.

vs.sum: Broadway's only thrust-stage theater offers an unmatched intimate experience — no seat is more than a few rows from the action. Sightlines are excellent from every angle, though some seats face actors' backs during certain scenes.

acc.note: Elevator accessible through adjoining building. Loop technology and neck induction systems available.
